snippet.title: [FR] Commented gameplay Trailer - City Tales - Medieval Era (AG French Direct)
snippet.description:
City Tales is available on now in Early Access on Steam: http://link.irregular-shapes.com/SteamPage

City Tales is a medieval strategic city builder with an organic building system, allowing you to create vast cities where every stone tells a tale. Balance your resources and plan each district whilst the lives of your companions and people unfold.
